contexts.api_surface: Rust library consumed by the daemon
contexts.description: Composes in-character chat replies from a character's constitution, rules, tone and working/long-term memory. Includes grammar, picker, pool, moderation and markdown-backed memory consolidation. Depends on the shared types crate and the engine for LLM calls.
contexts.name: brain-composition-memory

contexts.description: Console app entry: main, App composition, page registry and global CSS. Supporting keyboard keymap/conflicts, the QueryView/Placeholder kit, and formatting, heatmap, transcript and open helpers.
contexts.name: console-app-bootstrap

contexts.api_surface: Consumes daemon RPC and events
contexts.description: Console Brain page: visualizes the brain layers (layer 1 and 2), engine instruments, runs and a viewer. A canvas plot and palette back the drawing, with queries over the daemon.
contexts.name: console-brain-page

contexts.description: Console build tooling and Tauri desktop wrapper: Vite/TS config, bundle and DOM size budgets, check scripts for bundle, size and token refs, and fixture generation. The src-tauri crate hosts the desktop window and capabilities.
contexts.name: console-build-and-desktop-shell

contexts.api_surface: Consumes the daemon catalog RPC
contexts.description: Console Characters page: name plate, portrait, roster and a character package browser with docs, rules and situations tabs. Rules can be toggled live.
contexts.name: console-characters-page

contexts.api_surface: Client of the daemon JSON-RPC and websocket events
contexts.description: Console client data layer: a typed RPC and websocket connection to the daemon, cache with invalidation, result/error types and React bindings. A mock backend and the API context let the UI run offline.
contexts.name: console-data-layer

contexts.api_surface: Consumes daemon run/event RPC
contexts.description: Console On Air page: live show rundown, segment cards, dispatch, run detail and a screen preview rendered with stage-kit. A player and beats/feed models drive playback.
contexts.name: console-onair-page

contexts.api_surface: Consumes daemon reconcile RPC
contexts.description: Console Reconcile page: reports, plans, directives and a chat page over reconciliation results. It includes diff views, animated count-ups and a session model.
contexts.name: console-reconcile-page

contexts.api_surface: Consumes daemon segments RPC
contexts.description: Console Segments and Ranks page: segment lifecycle, the A/1 track with its descoped siding, a rank pyramid, vote calculator, command and table views.
contexts.name: console-segments-page

contexts.description: Console shell: chrome, intro, mixer bus, poster wall and spread layouts, with viewport and keyboard actions. Includes the client router (route parsing and store) that navigates between pages.
contexts.name: console-shell-router

contexts.api_surface: Consumes daemon sim RPC
contexts.description: Console Simulator page: an A/1 canvas tournament grid, runs, tournaments, and verdicts with quote checks, plus a heatmap. Drawing, cells and result models support it.
contexts.name: console-simulator-page

contexts.description: Reusable console UI primitives: chips, filter tables, pill groups, rate bars, sections, stat bands, loading/empty states, switches and a virtual list. Each is CSS-module styled with helper utilities and tests.
contexts.name: console-ui-primitives

contexts.api_surface: Typed contract for daemon RPC and events
contexts.description: TypeScript contract generated from the Rust-exported JSON Schema: generated types, validators and meta, with a door adapter and codegen/check scripts. Keeps the console and stage in sync with the daemon wire format.
contexts.name: contract-package

contexts.api_surface: JSON-RPC over websocket (engine.status, runs, catalog, paging, events) and CLI
contexts.description: The shadowrunr daemon: CLI, config, RPC server, live event streaming, paging, run management, preflight checks, catalog and policy installation. It wires the engine, brain, segments, sim and reconcile crates behind a websocket/RPC surface. E2E tests cover catalog, events, paging and resilience.
contexts.name: daemon-core-rpc

contexts.api_surface: MCP tools server, signed event forwarding
contexts.description: External integrations hosted by the daemon: an MCP server with tools and schema, event forwarder, signed webhooks, activity feed, door settings and status. They let outside systems observe and drive the show.
contexts.name: daemon-integrations

contexts.api_surface: Rust engine API consumed by the daemon, brain and sim
contexts.description: Drives LLM CLIs (Claude and alternates) as streaming sessions. Handles rate limits, health, a usage ledger, model fleet config and a scripted/fake CLI for tests. Recorded Claude JSONL fixtures back the tests.
contexts.name: engine-llm-sessions

contexts.api_surface: Rust library exposed via daemon RPC reconcile methods
contexts.description: Reconciles simulation runs against a character package. It verifies quotes, computes budgets, metrics and stats, and synthesizes directives for improving the character. It scales to any tournament size and uses simulation run fixtures and a malakor character fixture.
contexts.name: reconcile-engine

contexts.api_surface: Rust library consumed by the daemon
contexts.description: Defines the show's segment lifecycle, ranks, evidence rules, cases and command handling. Segment definitions and the primary-source allowlist live as TOML data. Runtime tests exercise the A/1 track and rank progression.
contexts.name: segments-runtime

contexts.api_surface: Rust library consumed by the daemon and the reconcile crate
contexts.description: Simulates chat audiences and tournaments against characters: populations, matrix runs, an LLM judge with a rubric, calibration, an instrument ledger, statistics and transcripts. Matrix TOMLs and the rubric/calibration under sim/ configure the runs.
contexts.name: sim-runner-judging

contexts.api_surface: Consumes the daemon live event stream
contexts.description: Standalone Vite stage app that plays a show from a demo JSONL/case fixture or a live source. It renders the stage via stage-kit with operator controls and layouts. DESIGN.md records the visual design intent.
contexts.name: stage-app

contexts.description: Broadcast overlay React components: captions, chat lane, decrees, explainer and foil cards, hexmap and panels, job ticker and vote panel. They render the scene model on the live stream.
contexts.name: stage-kit-overlays

contexts.description: Shared stage toolkit: parses the event stream into scene models, drives playback and timing, and computes tallies, hex grid layout, lore and chat memory. It includes the SVG character and foil art components. Used by both the stage app and the console On Air page.
contexts.name: stage-kit-scene-engine

contexts.description: Design tokens generated from tokens.source.json into CSS and TypeScript, with the bundled Barlow Condensed fonts and their licence. REJECTED.md records discarded options. Consumed by the console and stage.
contexts.name: tokens-package

contexts.api_surface: Defines the RPC and event shapes used on the wire
contexts.description: Shared Rust domain types: engine, chat, catalog, events, memory, reconcile, RPC, segment and sim structures plus errors. A JSON Schema is exported and a drift test guards it against the contract package.
contexts.name: types-crate

contexts.description: Monorepo configuration: pnpm workspace, Cargo workspace, TypeScript base, ESLint with boundaries, Stylelint, the example daemon TOML config and platform policy rules. Also covers project metadata files.
contexts.name: workspace-tooling-and-policy
console-quality-gates
contexts.description: Port-quality instruments for the operator console: the style-contract fidelity harness against the winning prototype, 10x scale perf counts, and per-route bundle and DOM budgets.
contexts.business_feature: Keeps the ported console faithful to the chosen design and within its performance budgets

contexts.name: character-package
contexts.description: The Malakor character package: immutable constitution, bible, tone variants, foils, optional rules and situations the brain and judge read.
contexts.business_feature: Defines who Malakor is and what he must never do

contexts.name: sim-instruments
contexts.description: Simulation instruments: audience calibration, the judge rubric, tournament matrices, and the platform word rules used by moderation and the clip factory.
contexts.business_feature: Sets how streams are tested before going live

contexts.api_surface: Calls the daemon review.* RPCs
contexts.description: Console Review page: the session wall (layer 1) and one session's tabs (layer 2): timeline, review by type, player, judge, moderation, engine calls, script and the operator feedback panel. Derives buckets and rows from the daemon's session record.
contexts.name: console-review-page

contexts.api_surface: Draws the face rig served at GET /avatar/{file}
contexts.description: The stage's WebGL2 face: lazy runtime, pose driver, visemes, layered rig and depth/cut renderers with their shaders, glow, and the bundled placeholder. One shared frame clock; idles when nothing moves and honours reduced motion.
contexts.name: stage-avatar-renderer

contexts.api_surface: GET /voice WebSocket (VoiceFrame)
contexts.description: The stage's voice session: follows the live run over the /voice WebSocket, plays rendered utterances through WebAudio, draws captions, and reports parts, dropped lines and the drawn face back to the daemon. Degrades without blocking the stream.
contexts.name: stage-voice-client

contexts.api_surface: Rust library plus daemon clips RPC/CLI
contexts.description: The clip factory and its publish gate: scores transcript beats from marker, chat, audio and hook signals, cuts windows snapped to lines and segment bands, drafts the best five per stream, renders footage and gates uploads. Daemon glue exposes it over RPC and CLI.
contexts.name: clips-pipeline

contexts.api_surface: GET /voice WebSocket, GET /avatar/{file}, voice CLI
contexts.description: The daemon's voice hub: hands each followed live say to the Python voice sidecar behind a renderer seam, bounds the queue and lag, forwards rendered utterances as VoiceFrames, logs voice.jsonl, replays, and serves the avatar rig files.
contexts.name: daemon-voice-service

contexts.api_surface: JSON lines on stdio (contract appendix voice)
contexts.description: Python voice sidecar: Kokoro via the operator's sherpa-onnx install, one sentence at a time, with mouth shapes from Kokoro's durations, a warm worker pool and text normalisation. Started by the daemon.
contexts.name: voice-sidecar

contexts.api_surface: Offline CLI producing layers.json and PNG layers
contexts.description: Offline tools that split the owner's portrait into the face rig the stage draws (region spec, masks, LaMa inpainting) and compute depth maps for the depth renderer. Owner images stay out of git.
contexts.name: avatar-rig-tools

contexts.api_surface: prep.*, review.*, record and sandbox RPC/CLI
contexts.description: Daemon services around a show: stream prep (planner, mechanical checks, approvals), session review (sessions, tagger, feedback log), the OBS recorder, media serving, the sandbox stream and casework, plus their end-to-end tests.
contexts.name: daemon-show-prep-and-review
